title: Connect the assistant to bounded delegation
description: Extend the Mastra assistant with narrow delegate, status and cancel operations. A task brief includes objective, workspace, constraints, acceptance criteria, context references and a stable task identifier. Ask only when missing information materially blocks the task. Keep a user conversation responsive while the worker runs. Do not let the supervisor directly edit code in this first slice.
why: The user should interact with one assistant rather than coordinate provider tools manually.

acceptance.text: A goal creates one bounded worker task
Status questions do not start another task
Final reply distinguishes produced output from verified acceptance

outcome.summary: Added an in-memory per-project task registry with bounded structured briefs, stable IDs, progress, one-active-task behavior, targeted cancellation, approval/question resume, five-minute expiry and explicit user-token confirmation. Added assistant tools for start/status/cancel/approval and an interactive terminal conversation. The assistant now returns after creating a task and waits for the user before polling.
outcome.verifiedBy: npm run check; npm run test:acp (7 passed); npm run test:policy (15 passed); live local Ollama smoke returned MASTRA_SMOKE_OK through existing Mastra server; live Codex read-only package.json delegation returned task ID 14c9c30d-5203-4772-8ea4-6017adc27065 and completed; subsequent user status query used getTaskStatus only; background smoke task 8ccb59ad-9402-4cab-89ed-f96ae35ac7b0 returned immediately and later completed; git diff --check
